t: OTHER USE OF COUNTY BOND PROCEEDS
ctx: SUBTITLE D. PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO SECURITIES ISSUED BY COUNTIES

items.t: USE OF BOND PROCEEDS FOR OWNER-CONTROLLED INSURANCE PROGRAM
l: A county may use the proceeds of bonds or certificates of obligation issued to pay for a county construction project to pay for an owner-controlled insurance program under which the county establishes and administers a consolidated insurance program for the project if the county's order authorizing the issuance of the bonds or other certificates of obligation authorizes the establishment of the program.
